# KamalYassin
For Area 1 Trustee
Santa Clara Unified School District
Volunteer →
“It's time for new leadership in SCUSD.”
## Priorities
### Empower Students’ Voices
Our students care - we need to respond to issues they care about like climate change, cyberbullying, AI, and more. They must be heard and trusted as we center decisions around their well-being and success.
### Elevate & Innovate
SCUSD is in the heart of Silicon Valley - EVERY student deserves full access to educational tools and resources raising the excellence of their learning.
### Support Educators
Our teachers and staff show up for our children every day and they deserve our full support to empower them in and out of the classroom.
### Fiscal Integrity
We need bold leadership that creates solutions for our schools instead of cutting programs and staff - securing more and better using your tax dollars for our students.
### Active District Leadership
A School Board that is proactive to fully secure safe spaces and will respond with the dignity and respect our students deserve as they seek to improve their own education.
## About Me
I believe in giving back to the community that has given so much to me, a place where our children are learning, growing, and building their futures.
Like so many families across Santa Clara and North San Jose, my journey began elsewhere. Born in Jordan, I arrived in the U.S. in 1999 to pursue my education. I earned my M.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte and later furthered my professional foundation by earning an MBA from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. My career brought me to the South Bay, and I’ve been proud to call this region home for over two decades, raising my four children within the Santa Clara Unified School District community.
My professional life has taken me through both industry giants, like Intel, and innovative startups. In these roles, I learned how to navigate complexity, solve high-stakes problems, and dismantle the bureaucratic red tape that too often stalls progress.
Deeply rooted in my values is the importance of ‘paying it forward.’ I’ve dedicated my time to building spaces where communities can thrive. I co-founded the MCA’s civic engagement committee and helped launch ‘Minterns,’ a network dedicated to mentoring young professionals.
As an SCUSD parent of four sons, it’s been important for me to be active in their education and in the district. My eldest graduated from MECHS School in 2024, his two brothers are currently enrolled there, and my youngest will start at Agnew in another year.
My wife and I have been active in the schools and the district, following up with teachers and attending meetings. I have stood up for our students, our families, and, most importantly, our educators, who are dedicated to helping students expand their learning and grow.
I believe it’s important to be present for our students outside the classroom, too, by volunteering as a soccer coach in the Santa Clara PAL league.
I believe in drawing on lessons from the past to craft a brighter future, one where every student has the freedom and the support to reach their full potential. I’m running for the Santa Clara Unified School District Board of Trustees in Area 1 to ensure that promise remains a reality for all our children.
